entities.name: Lord Zangari
entities.description: A minor noble of the High City in an unhappy marriage, who commissions a murderous music box to kill his wife.

entities.name: Aribelle
entities.description: Lord Zangari's wife, who gossips about his business misfortunes and loves music boxes.

entities.name: Iolanni
entities.description: A twenty-five-year-old widow with a dangerous reputation, Zangari's mistress, who suggests he visit Sydri.

entities.name: Sydri
entities.description: A highly skilled artificer in the High City who makes custom enchanted devices, including untraceable lethal ones.

entities.name: Earl Bartolotti
entities.description: The Earl whose grand ballroom hosts the Spring Gala.

entities.name: Lady Tirelli
entities.description: A noblewoman who reports what Aribelle is saying about Zangari.

entities.name: The High City
entities.description: The city where the nobility, Zangari and Sydri live.

entities.name: The Black Rose
entities.description: A political group in whose pocket Zangari refuses to put himself.

events.summary: At the Earl's Spring Gala, Lord Zangari fumes at his wife Aribelle, who is spreading word of his business misfortunes.
events.quote: According to Lady Tirelli, his wife Aribelle was telling anyone who would listen about the latest misfortune to befall Lord Zangari's business.

events.summary: Zangari vents his anger to his mistress Iolanni, who suggests he visit the artificer Sydri.
events.quote: There is a woman named Sydri. An artificer of extreme skill.

events.summary: Zangari realizes the suggestion is murder, and after Iolanni puts out the light he has made up his mind.
events.quote: By the time his eyes had adjusted to the darkness, Lord Zangari had already made up his mind.

events.summary: Zangari visits Sydri's shop and is forced to say aloud that he needs something to kill his wife.
events.quote: "I... I need something to help me kill my wife."

events.summary: Sydri names her price and instructs Zangari to bring a clipping of the wife's hair, her favorite music box, and half the money.
events.quote: Come back with a clipping of her hair, her favorite music box, and half the money.

events.summary: Zangari returns with the items; he admires a boar's-head broach in the shop, which Sydri says is for another client.
events.quote: "It's not for sale." Sydri emerged from the back room.

events.summary: On his third visit Sydri explains that the music box's enchantment will stop the wife's heart on the third hearing, and offers him a last chance to turn back.
events.quote: But this is your last chance to turn back from this.

events.summary: Zangari insists on the box; Sydri gives him it along with the broach as a refund gift.
events.quote: The smaller box is for you—my other client never picked up the broach.

events.summary: Dressing for his wife's birthday gala, Zangari fastens the broach, pricks his thumb on it, laughs uncontrollably, collapses on his bed and begins to die, the broach having been meant for him.
events.quote: He opened the clasp and fastened it through the cape. There was a brief flash of pain.

relations.note: Husband and wife in an unhappy marriage.
relations.quote: Zangari's marriage had never been a happy one
it was an open secret the apartment was a second home for him and his mistress.

relations.note: Iolanni was Sydri's friend for many years.
He plans to have her killed.
relations.quote: "I... I need something to help me kill my wife."
